naturalExperiment.task: 制作一个单HTML交互科普展页，主题是“下潜：从海面到深渊”。我希望画面有明确的空间深度、氛围和精细设计，而不是信息卡片模板。用户能控制下潜、暂停、回到海面，也能拖动深度查看对应环境，看到潜水器和沿途生物/地貌随着下潜变化。展页有一组可探索的科普标注，不把未经证实的说法当知识。桌面和手机都可用，键盘能完成主要操作。所有内容放在一个HTML，资源自行生成，不读取本地其他文件，不依赖网络。
naturalExperiment.initialSetupFault: 24000 output cap cut all three executor outputs before any final text; preserve failures, no quality inference.
naturalExperiment.productionAdjustment: Only executor outputs regenerated once with SDK production default output budget; no new optimization, same model/max/task/advice/criteria.

naturalExperiment.behavioralFinding: Both complete artifacts run offline with no page Runtime exceptions, mobile widths fit. Recovery manual scrub while paused fails because dt=0 freezes target interpolation; no manual code patch. Surface action works after its normal animation duration. Custom widget/native-input and reversed drag directions are not inherently defects.
naturalExperiment.screenshotLimit: Static screenshot ranking cannot determine dynamic knowledge/scene coupling; user actual experience says restored group clearly stronger.
naturalExperiment.coverageLimit: One unfamiliar open task, one artifact per valid arm, executor constrained to one no-tools artifact generation. No replicated general win and no full normal-agent/adviser workflow experiment.
naturalExperiment.effectConclusion: User experience supports the recovery direction on dynamic teaching coherence; offline/code friction fixes are established. Quality improvement is local and incomplete, cost reduction is disproven in this pair.

improvement.reasonNotAdopted: Invented subfield evidence IDs, nonexistent policy.hasStageState and unproved empty-guard flaw. Kept genuine stage failure/feedback regression checks.

report.summary: Supplied excerpts for the recovery patch show no concrete regression or authority weakening in the reviewed scope: core/tier separation is intact and gated on tier selection, advisor instructions remain opportunity-based and explicitly non-authorizing, compact stage summary preserves failed checkpoints with original IDs while full contracts stay in status/reviewSpec, partial diagnostics are explicitly non-acceptance, mode/stage validations return concrete corrections, and cancellation short-circuits before the paid fallback while fallback usage accounting stays complete/unknown rather than invented. Model quality improvement and full runtime/whole-project acceptance are neither shown nor claimed; the scope is a local code review only.

findings.text: F0: OPTIMIZER_CORE is a single frozen bilingual object while OPTIMIZER_TIERS carries three separately named tiers (light/standard/heavy) per language; the core states results are chosen 'according to the selected tier', so the historical core is preserved without collapsing tiers.

F0: Advisor brief and invocation strings repeatedly mark advice as adding no requirements and 'a consult opportunity is a hint, not permission'; no automatic scheduler/quota is introduced, consistent with the header comment.

F1: renderStageSummary counts all check statuses but only re-emits entries with status==='failed', preserving original id and truncated criterion (90 chars), decrementing omittedChecks and rolling back on the REVIEW_CONTEXT_LIMIT guard; full pending/stale contracts are explicitly said to remain in status/reviewSpec.

F1: Unregistered-stage feedback path reports verdict/scope/focus, failed and unverified counts, and states that recorded failed/unverified items remain open and that parameter edits or local self-tests do not themselves close a failed review; texts still call advice non-user-authorizing.

F2: incompleteDiagnostics only fires when output.partial===true, adding diagnosticOnly/adviceReady:false and a note that retained traces are unverified diagnostics rather than a completed recommendation or acceptance review; mode validation returns typed correction objects (invalid-advisor-input, invalid-current-result, invalid-stage-reference) with allowedModes and material-field guidance.

F2: On abort the tools path returns cancelled-no-retry before the plainDrain fallback, and fallback accounting sums both paid streams while setting usageComplete/usageKnownCalls/usageUnknownCalls from actual reports; unmatched data is not reported as zero. Test log F3 reports 296/296 passing, but tests do not establish model quality or runtime behavior.

checks.criterion: Historical contribution core is preserved and tiers remain separately selectable
Advisor instructions are opportunity-based, not scheduler/quota-driven, and add no user authorization
Compact stage feedback preserves failed checkpoints and full status while staying within limits
Partial output is explicitly marked non-acceptance diagnostics and API misuse returns concrete corrections
Cancellation avoids paid fallback and fallback usage is fully/unknown accounted rather than invented
No reviewed change grants new authorization or converts advice into user requirements
Model quality gains and a full runtime/whole-project acceptance claim are asserted by the change

report.nextStep: If broader assurance is required, run a minimal end-to-end invocation of the unchanged workflow (one real turn with tools disabled) and compare usage/cancellation fields against the F2 branches; otherwise close this scoped code review as a local pass only.
report.stopCondition: Stop when the scoped code review is accepted as local; any claim about model quality improvement or whole-project runtime acceptance needs separate evidence and a user decision.

codeReview.conclusion: Six local code checks satisfied; overall gaps retained because full runtime/model quality not proved. No formal whole-task acceptance or repeated vote.
